profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at General Motors
profile.summary:
My name is Sergio Morales, Scrum Lead / Senior Software Engineer at General Motors, where I've worked on controls software for the past 10 years. I'm currently involved in the in-house development of GM's next generation air suspension system for our software-defined vehicle architecture.

My passion is in embedded systems, computer architecture, and front end development. I enjoy cross-disciplinary projects like revamping software development processes, automating through AI or scripting, etc. Overall, I thrive on the challenge to find unique ways to solve problems.

You can find more of my skills in my resume, as well as past/current projects and my blog at: www.sergiomorales.me.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Scrum Lead - Vehicle Mechatronic Embedded Controls
positions.description:
I'm the Scrum Lead and Software Engineer within the Suspension ART, focusing on developing in-house air suspension controls for next-gen products. As a Scrum Lead, I aid in removing impediments (related to software development or external team dependencies), facilitate productive technical and SAFe related discussions, and deliver unique solutions and ideas to support continous development and integration of embedded software within my organization.

As a Software Engineer, I'm responsible for developing engine controls software that utilize sensors and actuators to optimize fuel economy, emissions, and driveability. Some of the features I work on specifically include torque estimation, air measurement, exhaust gas pressure and temperature estimation, air filter prognostics/monitoring, and PCV diagnostics.

Current environment utilizes Github, Jira Cloud / Jira Align, VSCode, and in-house tools developed within our team.

*Working 100% remotely from San Diego, California, but based in Milford, Michigan.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Scrum Lead - Vehicle Motion Embedded Controls
positions.description:
Scrum Lead and Software Engineer within the Gas Engine Product ART, focusing on developing controls software for engine torque estimation. As a Scrum Lead, I aid in removing impediments (related to software development or external team dependencies), facilitate productive technical and SAFe related discussions, and deliver unique solutions and ideas to support continous development and integration of embedded software within my organization.

As a Software Engineer, I'm responsible for developing engine controls software that utilize sensors and actuators to optimize fuel economy, emissions, and driveability. Some of the features I work on specifically include torque estimation, air measurement, exhaust gas pressure and temperature estimation, air filter prognostics/monitoring, and PCV diagnostics.

I utilize Matlab, Simulink, C/C++ IDEs (such as Eclipse), Git, Jenkins, Gerrit, RTC/Jira, CppUTest, and in-house tools.

*Working 100% remotely from San Diego, California, but based in Milford, Michigan.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Thermo Fluid & Chemical Software
positions.description:
Develop software that control multiple actuators in a way that optimizes fuel economy, emissions, and drivability. Features worked on include:

Closed loop fuel control,
Fuel System Diagnostics,
Oxygen Sensor, and
Ethanol compensation.

Notable projects include implementation of major multi-core stability/coherency restructuring, major software refactoring for fuel system diagnostics, and aiding with managing and building target independent ECU projects.

Software written in C, as well as through modeling in Simulink/Matlab. Responsibilities also include requirement analysis, bench testing, unit testing, and version control through Git. Based in Milford, MI, but work remotely from San Diego, CA.

positions.title: Business Owner
positions.description: Co-owner of an Etsy shop where we make custom hand-painted terracotta pots and other art. Responsible for supplies, shipping, and managing the shop. Shipped over a dozen orders and have maintained a 5-star rating from our customers.

positions.title: IT Student Worker
positions.description: Assist in help-desk tickets, maintenance, and troubleshooting hardware and software for the staff at the Department of Information Technology. Tasks include working with automating installation of software through running and creating scripts on a Windows OS environment, working as a lab technician for instructors in scheduled classes, and setting up workstations and routing the network for  desktop machines.

projects.title: C/C++ GameBoy Emulator
projects.description: A GameBoy emulator created from scratch in C/C++. Utilizes SDL/OpenGL, developed in Visual Studio.

projects.title: NES FPGA Emulator
projects.description:
As part of our Senior Design at UCR, we implemented a Nintendo Entertainment System Emulator using an FPGA (Field-programmable Gate Array) from the ground up.

My responsibilities included building a CPU core for the system, which was a CMOS 6502 microprocessor in C, as well as other controllers for Video and Input through Verilog modules on an Altera FPGA.

organizations.name: Association for Computing Machinery
organizations.description: Aimed towards promoting the advancement of computing as a science and profession. Activities include programming competitions, workshops, and other CS-related activities.

organizations.name: Society of Hispanic Professional Engineers
organizations.description: Academic/Professional organization designed to help students obtain professional connections to ultimately help with internships, research positions, or careers. In charge of maintaining the chapter website, and establishing communications between students and professionals.
